name: Putative copy-number alterations from DNAcopy.
description: Copy-number alterations from DNA copy. Calls made after normal contamination correction and CNV removal using thresholds. Values: -2 = homozygous deletion; -1 = hemizygous deletion; 0 = neutral / no change; 1 = gain; 2 = high level amplification.

name: Promoter methylation (RRBS)
description: Average methylation (beta-values) of promoters defined as 500bp upstream & 50 downstream of Transcription Start Site (TSS). With coverage >= 20 in 70% of the tumor samples and 70% of the normal samples. For genes with multiple promoters (alternate), the promoter with minimum methylation in the normal tissues is selected

name: mRNA expression (Illumina HT-12 v3 microarray)
description: Expression log2 intensity levels (Illumina HT-12 v3 microarray)

name: mRNA expression z-scores relative to all samples (log microarray)
description: Log2-transformed mRNA z-Scores compared to the expression distribution of all samples (Illumina HT-12 v3 microarray)

name: Mutations
description: Somatic mutation data from targeted sequencing of 173 genes of 2509 primary breast tumors with 548 matched normals.
